early_stops.rule: Stop the job if: the loss is not finite at any step; |dW| is not exactly 0 after step 1 (it runs at rate 0); KL(W0 || W_t) on the side's own rows at step 2 exceeds kl_step2_max_floors x the side's floor; or any single step raises that KL by more than kl_jump_max_floors x the floor (KL_t - KL_{t-1}, t >= 2, KL_0 = 0).

stop_at_15x: Training stops right after the read step that first reaches 15x the floor (its bracket written). If 15x is never reached, training runs to step 100, the step-100 state is saved, and the record says reached_15x false; the rule then reads step 100.
